Basis: Pandit 88094 is named Śālistambasūtra, authorless like the SETI row, and is the base text of Kamalaśīla's Ṭīkā (88841), which confirms it is the Buddhist sūtra. It is the only work of this name.

Pandit 85364 is Atīśa aka Dīpaṃkara Śrījñāna (1035), matching both the SETI name and its alternative, with his Buddhist works listed. There is a second, empty record 115363 Dīpaṅkaraśrījñāna that looks like a duplicate; 85364 is the fuller one.

Pandit 40377 Kālidāsa is the poet: it carries Kumārasaṃbhava, Meghadūta, Raghuvaṃśa, Abhijñānaśakuntala. 113710 Kālidāsa is an empty record that may be a duplicate, and 112242 is Śiśu Kālidāsa, a different person.
